newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies eight muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies eight muni issues for insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said Wednesday it qualified for bond insurance the following eight municipal issues:
--Urbandale Community School District, Iowa, $3.87 million general obligation refunding bonds.
--University of Louisville, Ky., $15.25 million refunding revenue bonds.
--Lauderdale County, Miss., $5.2 million GO road and bridge bonds.
--Averill Park Central School District, N.Y., $13 million GOs.
--Elmira Heights Central School District, N.Y., $4.61 million GOs.
